Cloud Application Tenant Resource Get Tags For Rule Association
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/casbTenant/:tenantId/tags/policy

Retrieves the tags used in the policy rules associated with a tenant, based on the tenant ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
tenantId
int32
REQUIRED

SaaS application tenant ID

QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size

Default value: 500
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
tagId
int32

System-generated tag ID

tenantId
int32

Tenant ID to which the tag belongs

deleted
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether or not a tag is deleted

tagUUID
string

Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the tag

tagName
string

Tag name

]
